reason: The ranger's "Favored Terrain" is two selections: the first pick at level 3 (which stays bare as the class's own copy) and the rank-ups at levels 8, 13 and 18. The Forester, a hunter archetype, adds the rank-ups at 9, 13 and 17, so the class's level doesn't hold on every route. This is qualified as the rank-up.
